description.narrative: The project will (i) reconstruct or upgrade and climate proof about 59 kilometers (km) of principal national roads, (ii) expand the road maintenance program of the Ministry of Infrastructure (MOI), and (iii) prepare a feasibility study and detailed design for 81 km of principal national roads. In collaboration with other development partners, the project will support the progressive upgrading of the whole of the national road network.

description.narrative: A more reliable and safer road network

By end 2020, 15% reduction in travel time on project roads (2012 baseline: 0.75 hours and 1.25 hours for Tibar to Liquica and Tibar to Gleno respectively to be updated by PMU for each subproject immediately prior to construction) Achievement: 15 Progress/Status: Civil works for Tibar-Liquica and Tibar to Gleno completed in 2016. PBM completed in 2018. Data Source: Project completion report prepared by MOI

By end 2024: 35% reduction in travel time on project roads (2014 baseline 0.2 hours for Tasitolou to Tibar) Achievement: 35 Progress/Status: Civil works for Tasitolou to Tibar road section 100% completed on 16 August 2021. Defects liability period was from 17 Aug 2021 to 16 August 2022 and currently in 24 months performance-based maintenance (PBM) from until August 2024. On government request, L3181-TIM closing date has been extended to 30 December 2024 to cover the PBM period. The Government of Timor-Leste, through a letter dated 25 August 2025 requested the ADB's post-facto approval to extend the loans' winding-up period by 6 months—from 30 April 2025 to 31 October 2025—on an exceptional basis. This extension aims to allow the liquidation request submitted to ADB on 16 May 2025 and to facilitate the closing of the advance account and the refund of unliquidated balances. Data Source: Project completion report prepared by MOI

By end of 2021, 50% reduction in travel time on roads c13, c16, and c17 (2014 baseline C13: 60 minutes; c16 and c17: 120 minutes) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: as of December 2024, a total of 43.86km completed with the following breakdown: C13 - 98.56% equivalent to 11.01km; C16/17 Package 1 -100% equivalent to 13.50km (completed in June 2020, DLP ended in June 2021); C16/17 Package 2 (original scope)- 100% equivalent to 16.03km completed; and C16/17 Package 2 - 2.52km missing link - 100.00% equivalent to 2.52km.
as of June 2025 - per MPW/PMU, VO.3 and VO.4, which have been cleared by ADB, are rejected by the Court of Audit. Subsequently, MPW proposes that the remaining funding and works for these works would be financed from the Government budget allocations.
as of June 2025 - C13 was completed in November 2022 with DLP until November 2023. During the DLP, road sections were seriously damaged by heavy rains. All damaged sections have already been repaired by the contractor, and the contractor agreed to an extended DLP until the end of June 2024. ADB reminded PMU to prepare and submit to ADB a request for post-facto approval for a variation order to the C13 civil works contract to include the repair works and associate additional cost to the contract scope. ADB explained to PMU that the current uncommitted grant proceeds are already allocated for VO.3 and VO.4 of the C16/17 Package 2 civil works contract. Disbursements or payments to the contractors are needed to free up grant proceeds under the miscellaneous category and become available for reallocation to the civil works category before ADB can approve a proposed VO with an increase in contract amount. In 1 October 2025, ADB approved the VO3 and VO4 for extension of time and increase in contract amount. Data Source: Project completion report prepared by MOI

Output: National roads will be upgraded and climate proofed Indicator: 1c. By end of 2021: 44 km of district roads will be rehabilitated and trafficable by non-4-wheel drive vehicles at all times including during the wet season Achievement: 40.54 Progress/Status: Under Grant 0504, a total of 43.86km has been completed with the following breakdown: C13 - 98.56%, equivalent to 11.01km; C16/17 Package 1 -100%, equivalent to 13.5km (completed in June 2020, DLP ended in June 2021); C16/17 Package 2 (original scope) - 100%, equivalent to 16.03km; and C16/17 Package 2 - 2.52km missing link - 100.00%, equivalent to 2.52km.
Note that as per civil works contracts, the total km for completion is 41.34km (93.95% of target 44kms) composed of 11.81km under C13; 13.50km under C16/17 Package 1; and 16.03km under C16/17 Package 2.
On 14 April 2021, ADB provided no objection to the proposed contract variation for additional works under civil works contract C16/17 Package 2 to include the following:
(i) Construction of the 2.52-km missing link between C16/17 Package 1 (station 32+045) and C16/17 Package 2 (station 0+000) road sections; (ii) Overlaying the existing pavement of about 100 meters to connect the public services area (i.e., sub-district administrator office, health, school, and other public facility/buildings) to the project road at station 14+60 at C16/17 Package 1; and (iii) Additional pavement works to widen total of 7.5km of C16/17 Package 1 road section from station 4+000 to station 11+500 from 3 meters to 5 meters by adding 1 meter each on both sides of road shoulder.
ADB's no objection to the proposed variation order was on the condition that the government will carry out due diligence to identify any environmental and/or land acquisition and resettlement impacts associated with the additional works by June 2021. Based on the findings of the due diligence, corresponding safeguards assessments and plans shall be prepared and submitted to ADB for review and clearance before any construction activities take place
The grant's closing date extension from 31 December 2023 until 20 June 2026 was approved by ADB. C13 was completed in November 2022 with DLP until November 2023. During the DLP, road sections were seriously damaged by heavy rains. All damaged sections have already been repaired by the contractor, and the contractor agreed to an extended DLP until the end of June 2024. ADB reminded PMU to prepare and submit to ADB a request for post-facto approval for a variation order to the C13 civil works contract to include the repair works and associate additional cost to the contract scope. ADB explained to PMU that the current uncommitted grant proceeds are already allocated for VO.3 of the C16/17 Package 2 civil works contract. Disbursements or payments to the contractors are needed to free up grant proceeds under the miscellaneous category and become available for reallocation to the civil works category before ADB can approve a proposed VO with an increase in contract amount.
MPW/PMU through a supplement letter dated 28 July 2021, informed ADB that it would like to prioritize the items proposed under VO.3 for C13 civil works contract over variation order number 2 for C16/17 Package 2 civil works contract. ADB provided no objection to VO.3 to C13 civil works contract through fax dated 14 Oct 2021. as of June 2025, MPW/PMU informed the mission that VO.3 and VO.4, which have been cleared by ADB, are rejected by the Court of Audit. Subsequently, MPW proposes that the remaining funding and works for these works would be financed from the Government budget allocations. On 1 October 2025, ADB approved VO3 and VO4 for extension of time and increase in contract amount.
